notes: R36 CUE-WIRING, 2026-10-22. Every row now says where its music is: delivered_file names the rendered OGG on disk, pending says there is none yet, and fallback names the landed cue the bus should play instead. A cue is landed when assets/audio/<asset>/<asset>.ogg exists, which is the path game/scripts/pp_audio/pp_audio.gml builds from asset.

Six of the seventeen cues are landed: PP-01 title, PP-02 drive, PP-03 harbor, PP-04 navy sailors, PP-05 small ship, PP-06 Percy. Eleven are pending with a fallback that itself resolves to a landed cue, so the chain always terminates at a file.

Volume 0.7 and loop true on every cue are spec 12: rule 1 plays music with loop on, and the volume table sets music at 0.7 (the module macro PP_AUDIO_GAIN_MUSIC is the same number). crossfade_steps 30 mirrors the module macro PP_AUDIO_FADE_STEPS, which stays the authority.

placeholder is the pre-delivery flag and is now stale for the six landed rows: it still reads true because tests/test_audio.py and tests/test_check_data.py pin it true for every row and this card owns data/audio.json only. Read pending and delivered_file, not placeholder. Q: for gamedev, whether those two tests should follow delivery.

The music entries left in sounds (ship_ambient, battle_tutorial, battle_percy, pp_07_prometheus) name OGG files that are not in assets/audio, so the placeholder_sound path is silent; that dead path is pinned by tests/test_audio.py. The cue fallback field is its replacement, but pp_audio_music does not read fallback yet. Q: for gamedev, the bus code.
PP-03 points at pp_03_harbor, the master the R35 ear gate scored. assets/audio/pp_03_harbor_v2/pp_03_harbor_v2.ogg was rendered at 19:42 by another card after that gate and is not adopted here.

PP-02 points at pp_drive_v2.ogg. The ear gate scored pp_drive_v2_humanized.mp3, and no OGG of the humanized master exists, so the shipped stream is the pre-humanized render; rendering the humanized master to OGG is still open.

The two stingers the slice plays are now in sounds with loop false: game_over (the death sting) and save_jingle. pp_audio_sfx already plays every effect with loop off, so this records the decision in data rather than changing it.

DRIVE-SFX, 2026-10-24 (card t_c365ff5d). The drive's two effects are rows now: the engine loop held under the whole film, composed by tools/sfx.py and the set's only loop, and the thunder on its first lightning, which had been on disk since SFX-1 and needed only the row. Both are kind sfx and both name a delivered_file under assets/audio/sfx, so a scene command for either resolves. Neither is a cue: effects are not music and must not reach the cue table.

sounds.note: The death sting the ear gate scored. Loop false on purpose: a lost run must not have a jingle under it.
The save point cue, 1.4 s, played once.

The car engine under shots 2 to 12 of knowledge/DRIVE-SHOT-LIST.md, the one effect that loops. Composed for this id by tools/sfx.py: 0.800 s, a four cylinder idle at 60 Hz firing with a 30 Hz crank order and a 120 Hz second order, built from three periodic voices and an LFSR tick so the file is one 4410 sample pattern repeated eight times. Its loop points (0 and 35280 samples) are Vorbis comments in the OGG itself, per spec 12 rule 3. Volume 0.35 because it is a bed under the whole film, not an event. Q: for gamedev, pp_audio_sfx plays every effect with loop off, so the drive needs a looping play call (or a music-slot ambience) before this file can actually loop in the runner.

The first lightning in shot 10 of the drive. The asset has been on disk since card SFX-1 (assets/audio/sfx/thunder_soft.ogg and .wav, 1.450 s) and had no row here, so a scene command sfx thunder_soft failed the reference check; this row is the wiring, not a new sound.

sounds.speaker: zeus
sounds.note: PP-BLIPS (card t_c9232c57). Zeus's talk blip: a mid square at A4, 70 ms. Kind ui and volume 0.9 because pp_audio_blip is the one place the 0.5 blip level and the priority 4 are applied (spec 12 rules 2 and 6). Played every second letter of a talk box, never on a space.

sounds.speaker: kronos
sounds.note: PP-BLIPS (card t_c9232c57). Kronos's talk blip: a low triangle at A2 with a 40 ms repeat at 45 percent, the slight delay the card asks for, built into the sound so the bus needs no per speaker timing.

sounds.speaker: percy
sounds.note: PP-BLIPS (card t_c9232c57). Lt. Percy's talk blip: a harsh short mode noise burst over a falling square. The only blip that is noise rather than a pulse or a triangle, which is how he is told apart on a small speaker.

sounds.speaker: old_man
sounds.note: PP-BLIPS (card t_c9232c57). The old man's talk blip: a soft high square at E6 with a 6 ms attack. Volume 0.55 rather than 0.9 because softness cannot live in the file, where every effect is normalised to the same peak.

sounds.speaker: narrator
sounds.note: PP-BLIPS (card t_c9232c57). The narrator's talk blip: a neutral tick at E4, 55 ms, unaccented. The default the speaker map falls back to.
PP-BLIPS (card t_c9232c57). The first of two alternating steps. Volume 0.35 is the quiet the card asks for, the same level as the drive's engine bed: a footstep is furniture, not an event.
PP-BLIPS (card t_c9232c57). The second alternating step: brighter noise clock, lower thud, 10 ms longer, so the walk alternates instead of stuttering one sound.
PP-BLIPS (card t_c9232c57). A knife slash: a noise sweep down, a metallic short mode edge and a falling square body, 220 ms. New for this card; the set had no blade.
